messages:
maria (support): Hey team — customer on iOS sees intermittent 401s and a latency spike. They aren't technical and keep saying "app shows an error". What's the shortest set of steps I can DM them to get a request id / debug token so we can pull traces? :thinking:

sam (eng): Quick checklist to DM them: app version, time of failure, screenshot of the error screen. Then 3 simple options depending on what they can do. Keep each option 1-2 lines.

maria (support): please write them out, I will paste into the chat with the customer.

sam (eng): Option A — easiest (non-technical):
1) Open the app -> Settings -> Help -> Send diagnostics (or "Share debug info"). Tap it and copy the short code shown (example: debug-abc123). Send that code to us.
2) Also send one screenshot of the error and the time you saw it.

Option B — browser or desktop web:
1) Open the page, reproduce the error. Press F12 -> Network tab.
2) Find the POST to /v1 (filter by "POST" or "/v1"). Click the request -> Headers -> look for header named `x-request-ref` or `x-redwood-request-id`. Copy the value and paste it back here.

Option C — if they can run one copy-paste command (advanced but short):
- Reproduce the error, then run this curl (replace placeholders):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>" \
  -H "x-request-ref: <PASTED_REQUEST_REF>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwoood-inference.com/v1/generate
```
Send back the `x-request-ref` value and the exact timestamp (local time) when you saw the error.

If none of that works: give us the exact local time (HH:MM + timezone) and the email they used to sign up and we'll search server-side for matching traces.

liam (sre): A couple of tiny extras to add to the DM: if they're on mobile, ask them to try briefly switching from Wi‑Fi to cellular and reproduce — proxies at customer networks sometimes strip headers. Also ask them to toggle airplane mode off/on before retrying (quick network reset). :iphone:

eng-bot: Reminder — do not paste any full API keys or PII in public channels. If customer sends a debug bundle code, mark the thread private and drop into #support-escalations.

maria (support): Perfect — I'll send that now. One more: where exactly is the debug code shown in the mobile flow? Some customers say they tapped "Send diagnostics" and saw nothing.

sam (eng): On iOS we show a small dialog after sending: "Diagnostics sent — code: <short-code>". Sometimes the OS share sheet hides it; instruct them to wait 3-4 seconds after tapping and look for a short alphanumeric code (6-10 chars). If they still don't see it, ask them to go to Settings -> Help -> Diagnostics history and pick the latest entry and copy the code.

liam (sre): For Android, if Send diagnostics isn't available: Settings -> About -> App logs -> Export (creates a share code), or they can take a screenshot of the logs view which includes a "session=" hex string near the top. That session hash maps to traces on our side.

maria (support): Copying into the DM: concise, step-by-step for non-technical users + the fallback asking for time/email. Will post and update here. :thumbsup:

(20 minutes later) maria (support): Customer sent back: screenshot of error, says "No diagnostics option in my app", but pasted this small token from logs view: `sess-fa9b3c` and local time 14:22 PST. Also said they were on their home Wi‑Fi.

sam (eng): Great — forward `sess-fa9b3c` and time to me and liam. We'll search the tracing service. If we don't find it, ask for the app build number (Settings -> About -> Build).

liam (sre): On our side: searching for session `fa9b3c` between 14:15-14:30 PST. If we find a span, we'll paste the server request id here and then give a minimal curl the customer can run to reproduce (if they want).

maria (support): Thanks all. One small note for the DM: add this single-line curl for advanced users (replace `X` tokens):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your-token>" \
  -H "x-request-ref: <server-request-id>" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

sam (eng): Nice. Also if the customer can't copy headers, tell them to long-press the error screen and choose "Share log" — some Android skins bundle the header values in the share text.

maria (support): DM sent. I'll post updates once I have the server request id or a debug bundle code. Thanks! :sparkles:
